rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Thor, the red-haired bearded hammer-bearing protector.
ANATOMY: one human male head, two arms, long red hair and great red beard; iron gloves gripping plain Mjolnir hammer, strength belt; fully opaque rugged tunic and cloak [thor-c02, thor-c22, thor-c34]
MOMENT: Drive the hammer downward toward the foreground ridge, beard whipping and iron glove huge in foreground; rock fractures under the hammer at bottom of frame
POWER: a hammer blow levels mountain rock; stone fragments burst physically from contact, storm and lightning visible in sky [thor-c23, thor-c27]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low camera, tight framing and strong foreshortening; subject occupies most of square, no invented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: lightning illuminating the storm sky and the contact-blasted stone; dramatic rim light and deep shadows.
SURFACE: tangible weathered opaque cloth, tactile skin and stone; dark walnut and antique gold palette.
SETTING: rocky mountains in the mountain-striking story [thor-c23]
MOOD: overwhelming majestic dignity, determined expression, awe inspiring active divine presence, never ordinary or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text anywhere including clothing and stone, no pseudo glyphs, no lettering, signature, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no film/game/anime/comic design; fully opaque clothing, no nudity, no explicit gore, no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons or runes.
